data.title: 新条茜 · 海边的怪兽沙堡
data.description: 【城市海滨沙滩·正午】茜穿着淡紫泳装蹲在沙堡旁，用贝壳给一只小怪兽沙雕做眼睛；她完成后将承托作品的小平木板轻推向镜头，红色眼睛里映着阳光和海水，笑容比任何社交场合都更自然。
data.location: quiet city beach away from the crowds
data.action: 沙滩上用贝壳给怪兽沙雕装眼睛，完成后把承托作品的小平木板轻推向镜头自然微笑
data.lighting: strong noon sun with warm sand bounce
data.mood: 把孤独做成可以分享的沙堡
data.promptProse: Akane Shinjou from SSSS.GRIDMAN wears a lavender swimsuit with a white sun shirt, shell hair clips and a small monster sand sculpture kit. She kneels beside a sandcastle and gives a tiny monster sand sculpture on a small flat wooden board two shell eyes. She gently slides the supporting board toward the viewer with a bright, unguarded smile, her pale-purple hair lifting as sunlight and sea spray animate the quiet beach. strong noon sun with warm sand bounce.
